from.place: The final assertion that every lifted term whose reduction is free is itself free.

title: Freeness of a finite projective module detected modulo a Jacobson ideal
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, I an ideal such that every element of 1+I is a unit, and P a finite [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] projective [def-weil-pbc-projective-module] R-module. If (R/I) ⊗_R P is free [def-weil-pbc-free-module], then P is free.

source.place: Tag 0BC6, isomorphism lifting, applied to a free module

proof.text: The reduction of P is finite. Choose a finite basis and let A be the free R-module with the same basis index. Its reduced basis determines an isomorphism e : (R/I) ⊗ A ≃ (R/I) ⊗ P. Projectivity of A lifts the map A → P/IP through the surjective map P → P/IP. Tensor extensionality shows that the lift f has reduced map e.

source.place: Tag 0BC6, isomorphism lifting, applied to a free module

proof.text: Since the reduction of f is surjective, the surjectivity-detection lemma makes f surjective. Projectivity of P gives a section g with fg=id. Reduction and injectivity of e give the second identity gf=id modulo I; surjectivity detection therefore makes gf surjective.

source.place: Tag 0BC6, isomorphism lifting, applied to a free module

proof.text: The finite-module surjective-endomorphism theorem makes gf injective, hence f injective. Thus f is bijective and transfers freeness from A to P. The construction also covers zero rings and empty basis indices.

theorem free_of_free_extendScalars_mod_ideal
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R)
    (hunits : ∀ x : I, IsUnit (1 + (x : R)))
    (P : ModuleCat.{max u v} R) [Module.Finite R P] [Module.Projective R P]
    [Module.Free (R ⧸ I) ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).obj P)] :
    Module.Free R P
